notes:
Card shape kept: family-config TagDriver with the epics-ca profile over the caproto IOC's PVs (no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD). The hardware factory is native.py:connect (a caproto.threading.client Channel Access transport for the operator's PV prefix) and the fake is .fake:FakeADR. Fake evidence only (contract_checked): no hardware, EPICS IOC, Channel Access client, ZeroMQ endpoint or human review was used, and driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null, so every hardware backend is refused. The stop is PAUSE=1 (pausePID) confirmed by a fresh read of the IOC's PAUSE PV. It pauses the PID loop; it does not command the heater off, abort a magnet cycle or prove physical quiescence, and the external ADR controller may keep its last state. The clone's command() closes its ZeroMQ REQ socket without reading a reply, so no device-side command acknowledgement exists. The start_mag_cycle action is fire-and-forget: its output only records that the IOC accepted the start write, and the tag-bridge helper has no long-running or completion path. The clone states no temperature setpoint range and no HEATER_OUT unit: setpoint is Limit.operator_required (site-limits.example.json is an illustrative overlay that must be replaced), and HEATER_OUT is published without a unit. The deployment EPICS PV prefix is an operator option of native.py; the upstream argument-parser default is not used as a fact or a default. NOT COVERED: the direct ZeroMQ control/subscription protocol (only the IOC PVs are addressed), magnet-cycle completion or cancellation, a heater-off/de-energization path, a physical e-stop citation, CA network failures, and any real hardware or EPICS run. The fake models only a deterministic point store and the TEMP_SP to TEMP_SP_RB read-back; it models no PID loop, heater, magnet cycle, ZeroMQ traffic, Channel Access error or timing, and all of its numbers are placeholders. Licence is NOASSERTION and the clone has no licence file or package metadata, so publication waits for the owner's decision.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the author's R2 package against cryostat.py and the tag-bridge preflight, which gives this card an R0 observer scope only. The pass rested on an invented stop: PAUSE=1, confirmed by reading PAUSE back, was the e-stop and safe-state action, but the putter only forwards pausePID on a ZeroMQ REQ socket that command closes without reading a reply (cryostat.py:43-58) and a caproto pvproperty keeps the value its putter accepted, so the read-back proves the IOC stored the put, not that the controller paused; the package also served the TEMP_SP write and start_mag_cycle (60-67), and nothing stops a started magnet cycle. The reviewer converted it to the preflight's R0 observer: seven read points and one observation x-cap.nsls-ii-sst.adr_readings.v1 (verb read), no write, command or stop, units only where the clone states them, three facts made precise and one added (driver.py, fake.py, test_driver.py, facts.md, native.py docstring); site-limits.example.json and fixtures/conformance.json, which served the removed write, were moved aside to review/lists/r26-moved-aside/; reference.json and REFERENCE.md regenerated. The gate passes with G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and the new digest sha256:722ff3bad07a44354144018a0a720f01f083005cc74ad62bab7b029c7aa51c74; the author's notes and catalogue requests about the R2 PAUSE stop, the setpoint write and the cycle start are superseded. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Observation only: values are the IOC's last ZeroMQ-fed values (0.1 s scan), not fresh samples, and a silent controller leaves them in place. TEMP_SP, PAUSE and START_CYCLE stay NOT COVERED until a stop the ADR controller acknowledges exists (adr_gui is outside the clone). Every TagDriver hardware backend needs a human reviewed_by. No licence file in the clone (NOASSERTION).

catalogue_requests.summary: Read the ADR temperature, setpoint read-back, RMS stability, second channel, heater output and mode that the caproto IOC publishes.
catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class reads a fixed set of named cryostat IOC points with partly stated units; cap.sensing.read.v1 has an open values object. The reviewed R0 observer uses an x-cap id with an inline output schema meanwhile.
